r: **Satya + agraha** = insistence on (holding to) truth; "**soul force**" / "truth force" in place of physical force
Its early English name – but passive resistance = weapon of the weak, **satyagraha = weapon of the strongest**
**Using passive resistance (satyagraha) to win Indian independence**
**Not to defeat the enemy** but to **change his heart**
**No ill feeling** towards the opponent; **firm in his belief**
Two-fold method for conflicts = **non-violence and satyagraha**

0.x: Rules: **never insult the opponent**; bear assaults **without retaliation**; **submit to arrest**; obey jail discipline.
Forms: non-cooperation, boycott, picketing, hartal, strike, civil disobedience, **fasting**.
**Fasting = the last weapon**: "Fasting unto death is the **last and the most potent weapon** in the armoury of Satyagraha" (Harijan, 18 Aug 1946) – used only when all other avenues have failed.
In Gandhi's words **fasting is the last resort** of satyagraha.

r: **Truth is the end; non-violence (ahimsa) is the means** – two sides of one coin; non-violence is **a way to attain truth**
**"God is Truth"** = earlier; **"Truth is God"** = later
In **thought, word and deed**; a quality of the **strong (brave)**, not the weak
Between **cowardice and violence**, Gandhi would choose **violence**
"**Wrong means never take us to right ends**"
"Means are after all everything. **As the means so the end**"
"What is morally wrong can never be politically right"
Religion = morality of truth and non-violence
"Real swaraj … the **capacity of all to resist authority when abused**"
"Swaraj will not be a **free gift of the British Parliament**; it will be a declaration of India's full self-expression"
Recall the face of the **poorest and weakest**
**Activity for public welfare**, built on **ethics, religion and humanity** – **no place for authority**
More than political freedom: **self-rule, self-control** and the capacity of the masses to govern themselves
**Swadeshi, ahimsa, satyagraha, decentralisation, education for all** (**class dictatorship** has no place)
Ideal of "**enlightened anarchy**"; the State = **violence in concentrated form**
Blend of Marxism and Gandhism, with a **Gandhian tilt**
The Kingdom of God is Within You
For him the essence of Christ's teaching
